#016 · Tiny Bird Pokémon

Pidgey

Normal Flying

Kanto · Generation 1

Pidgey is a Normal/Flying-type Tiny Bird Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 1.8 kg. It evolves into Pidgeotto. Its highest base stat is Speed (56), with a base stat total of 251.
